title: Validate registered recording candidates and preservation rules
description: Only structurally admissible, explicitly authored record candidates proceed, and correction remains possible when substantive work is incomplete or observations contradict a recorded claim. This logical behavior has the scope and limits of SR-042; retained v3 realization facets require reconciliation before replacement-store adoption.
inputs: Explicit supported operation, selected project/Change and expected coherent state.
Actor-supplied candidate or verified recovery basis, with declared subject and artifact identities.
outputs: Exact attributable result or explicit conflict, unavailability, rejection or recovery-required outcome.
behavior: Unknown fields or vocabularies, duplicate keys or identities, missing required values, unsupported encodings/versions, mixed stores, dual report representations, and malformed current records reject before authoritative writes.

Every supporting record has an unambiguous identity, owning Change and kind, with explicit applicability wherever the selected contract requires a reliance decision. References resolve exactly one admissible object in the complete candidate; storage-layout adjacency grants no authority and cross-Change fallback cannot repair an unresolved reference.

Actor-supplied status, subjects, applicability, narrative order, provenance, and decisions are preserved. Failed evidence, completed activity, stale external subjects, or absent conditional verification basis alone do not prohibit a structurally sound correction or establish approval.

Omitted issues survive updates. V4 requires explicit attributable disposition before compaction, preserves current judgment ownership and support still relied upon, and permits replacement of superseded accounts. V3 finding and immutable blocker-origin rules remain version-scoped.

Review/Verify use their closed explanation fields; the optional Verify basis is either absent or complete and never inferred from prose, required universally, or resolved as a Git instruction. Exact source shape and reliance policy remain distinct.

failure_behavior.condition: The requested candidate, expected state or recovery basis cannot be established safely.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the corresponding bounded rejection, conflict or recovery condition without invented decisions, silent merge or unrelated overwrite.
